flex-1 (6): People Around the World Help Buy Royal Estate for Wildlife Conservation
flex-1 (7): [{"_type":"block","_key":"icbaey6rc","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"kntkb4vwo","text":"The curlew, mountain bumblebee, lapwing, and other wading birds are just some of the animals calling a one-of-a-kind noble estate home."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"le5q6r4p9","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"oxdrep704","text":"Now, people around the world have come together to donate millions to buy this critical piece of biodiverse land which had been in the hands of a British noble family for 800 years."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"utnztltw5","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"bkd5g3376","text":"Sir David Attenborough celebrated the achievement, saying that “together, we’ve achieved something amazing.”"}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"s05aunco0","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"od7i4u46z","text":"Attenborough is referring to the Rothbury Estate in Northumberland, described by the UK’s Wildlife Trusts as “a place of rare beauty… rolling moorlands, woodlands, and wide-open starry skies.”"}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"xaz6zgbih","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"kk7oms459","text":"Owned since the 13th century by the Dukes of Northumberland, it was recently acquired by the Wildlife Trusts following a remarkable funding call that saw £30 million be donated from over 25,000 supporters from 50 countries."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"3uhizw1hs","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"4m0cgci16","text":"The plan for the estate, which covers 9,400 acres of the Scottish-English border, is to incorporate it into a 40-mile nature corridor across Northern England, stretching from Druridge Bay on the coastline to the east to an existing nature reserve to the west, and the estate, which had divided this key “moor to mar” ecosystem, right in the middle."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"1mpyy70ak","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"072un08ll","text":"\n"}]}]
Personas de todo el mundo ayudan a comprar una finca real para la conservación de la vida silvestre
flex-1 (8): [{"_type":"block","_key":"icbaey6rc","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"kntkb4vwo","text":"El zarapito, el abejorro de montaña, la avefría y otras aves zancudas son solo algunos de los animales que tienen su hogar en una finca nobiliaria única en su tipo."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"le5q6r4p9","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"oxdrep704","text":"Ahora, personas de todo el mundo se han unido para donar millones y comprar este terreno crítico de biodiversidad que había estado en manos de una familia noble británica durante 800 años."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"utnztltw5","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"bkd5g3376","text":"Sir David Attenborough celebró el logro, diciendo que «juntos hemos conseguido algo increíble»."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"s05aunco0","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"od7i4u46z","text":"Attenborough se refiere a la Finca Rothbury en Northumberland, descrita por los Wildlife Trusts del Reino Unido como «un lugar de rara belleza… páramos ondulantes, bosques y amplios cielos estrellados»."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"xaz6zgbih","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"kk7oms459","text":"Propiedad desde el siglo XIII de los duques de Northumberland, fue adquirida recientemente por los Wildlife Trusts tras una notable campaña de recaudación de fondos en la que se donaron 30 millones de libras por parte de más de 25.000 simpatizantes de 50 países."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"3uhizw1hs","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"4m0cgci16","text":"El plan para la finca, que abarca 9.400 acres de la frontera entre Escocia e Inglaterra, es incorporarla a un corredor natural de 40 millas a través del norte de Inglaterra, que se extiende desde la bahía de Druridge en la costa, al este, hasta una reserva natural existente al oeste, con la finca, que había dividido este ecosistema clave «del páramo al mar», justo en el medio."}]},{"_type":"block","_key":"1mpyy70ak","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"072un08ll","text":"\n"}]}]
